claims.claim: time-like p (Q(p) < 0, H^2_+ and H^2_- at once): every rho in Gamma_p acts on T_pHS^2 = p^perp (Euclidean) as a rotation, and pslMk (gammaToSL theta rho) is elliptic or 1, for every theta
claims.note: 'rotation' is stated without a basis: Q o dsProj is positive definite on T_pHS^2, its polar form is preserved, det = 1 (tangent_isRotation_of_timelike); dsProj maps T_pHS^2 onto p^perp (range_dsProj). Sharper than the target: pslMk (gammaToSL theta rho) = 1 iff rho is 1 or the half-turn gammaHalfTurn, elliptic (tr^2 < 4) otherwise.

claims.claim: light-like p (Q(p) = 0, both components): every rho != 1 is unipotent on T_pHS^2, fixes no direction but the two tangent ones, and pslMk (gammaToSL theta rho) is parabolic (single-element form of GX.fixedPoints_eq_of_null)
claims.note: Sharper than the target: (T - 1)^2 = 0 for every rho (T - 1 != 0 iff rho != 1); no direction is reversed by any rho; tr = 2; parabolic iff rho != 1; the fixed points on RP1 of pslMk (gammaToSL theta rho), rho != 1, are exactly linkToRP1 of the tangent directions.

findings: colI_v1.tex l.789-790, bearing on OQ-113 (b)/(d): under the double-cover RP1-structure of ℓ(p) (OQ-113 (b)), the holonomy map Γ_p → PSL(2,R), ρ ↦ pslMk (gammaToSL θ ρ), has kernel {1, half-turn} at a time-like p (GX.GammaP.pslMk_gammaToSL_eq_one_iff_of_timelike, GX.GammaP.gammaHalfTurn_ne_one) and is injective at a light-like p (GX.GammaP.pslMk_gammaToSL_eq_one_iff_of_null). So a time-like (Γ_p, ℓ(p))-circle whose holonomy is the half-turn (e.g. the link of a hyperbolic cone point of angle π, whose tangent holonomy is −id) has central PSL-holonomy: l.790's « L is an elliptic RP1-circle » for it needs OQ-113 (d) (central counted as elliptic). It is not only the regular link. The single-element statement « elliptic or 1 » is true under either reading.

The target's claims are true as stated. Two are sharpened: at a time-like p, pslMk (gammaToSL θ ρ) = 1 exactly for ρ ∈ {1, half-turn}; at a light-like p, unipotency (T - 1)^2 = 0 holds for every ρ, ρ = 1 included, and no ρ reverses a direction.
questions: l.798 « Γ_p is generated by a parabolic element » (and l.794-795 « generated by hyperbolic element » at dS^2): Γ_p is a one-parameter group (null rotations, ≅ R; boosts, ≅ R), so it is not cyclic. Argued, not formalized. Reading taken: every element ≠ 1 is parabolic (resp. hyperbolic), which is what GX.GammaP.isParabolic_iff_of_null proves at a light-like p.
« elliptic » for single elements (OQ-113 (d), open): stated as GX.PSL2.IsElliptic (tr^2 < 4) OR = 1, with the exact equality case. True under either reading, so no reading is taken.
kb_proposals: At a time-like p, Q o dsProj is positive definite on T_pHS^2 (GX.GammaP.minkQ_dsProj_pos_of_timelike, by Cauchy-Schwarz in coordinates). An eigenvector of the tangent action forces ±id (GX.GammaP.tangent_eq_smul_of_timelike): take the B-orthogonal e = Q(σ)·e₀ − B(σ,e₀)·σ, then Cramer and linkArea_tangent. The only elements of Γ_p with an eigen-ray are 1 and gammaHalfTurn.

At a light-like p, Γ_p is unipotent on T_pHS^2 without a basis: T − 1 maps into ker B(p,·), where T = 1 (GX.GammaP.tangent_eq_self_of_null, via det = 1), so (T − 1)^2 = 0. The only real eigenvalue is 1 (GX.GammaP.eigen_eq_one_of_null).

From a lift f with linkCover (f t) = ρ • linkCover t to toPSL f = pslMk (gammaToSL θ ρ): GTilde.toPSL_eq_iff.2 fun t => by rw [← linkToRP1_linkCover, hρf, linkToRP1_smul, linkToRP1_linkCover]. pslMk (gammaToSL θ ρ) = 1 iff the tangent action is ±id (GX.GammaP.pslMk_gammaToSL_eq_one_iff). A fixed point on RP1 is an eigen-ray (GX.GammaP.exists_tangent_eq_smul_of_fixed).
